sentences: Same salary, yet your little sister repays almost {£400|four hundred pounds} more a year.
Same job. Same degree. Same loan company.
But she started uni in autumn {2023,|twenty twenty-three,} on the newer plan.
Hers starts at {£25,000.|twenty-five thousand pounds.} Yours waits till nearly {£30,000.|thirty thousand.}
But here's the part nobody tells her.
Whatever's left at the end gets wiped.
Yours is wiped after thirty years. Hers runs ten years longer.
Her interest is a bit lower. But her loan can last longer.
So next time you compare payslips, remember:
